name: Dig your way out

categories.label: Tunnel points
categories.hint: Spoon 1, Pickaxe 2, Shovel 3 per Dig action; first to the target ends the game

winCondition: The first player to reach the Tunnel points target wins immediately: 12 pts with 2-3 players, 10 pts with 4, 8 pts with 5-6. All other prisoners lose.
notes: family: race-to-target. Tunnel points come from Dig actions (Spoon 1, Pickaxe 2, Shovel 3). Game ends the instant a target is reached, so no tiebreak. Only the Dig action is confirmed as a point source; Background/Gang card effects that might add points were not itemised. Rulebook text read via a third-party transcription, not the publisher PDF.

sources.title: Dig Your Way Out rulebook transcription (RulesPal)
